purpose: Separate already-granted award allocation from recurring economic cost of grants made after the June 30 origin. All amounts USD millions/shares millions unless stated.
proxy_limitations: Gross quantity times weighted grant-date fair value, before forfeitures. ESPP purchase quantities proxy grant quantities across overlapping offerings; performance accounting quantities are not maximum contractual settlement units. These are approximate annual grant-value proxies, neither exact total grants nor amortized GAAP expense.
future_grant_cost_policy: Post-origin new-grant value is an economic labor expense at 12%/10.2%/9% of revenue for downside/base/upside. The base approximates the three-year revenue-weighted proxy. No future-grant units are added again to the denominator. R&D remains expensed and includes its allocated grant cost; overlapping R&D and SBC percentages must not be summed.
stub_policy: FY26 guidance accounting SBC569 less H1 actual285.073 gives H2 accounting SBC283.927. Add that accounting amount back, then charge post-origin economic new-grant cost against H2 revenue. This is a replacement, never a free SBC add-back. Existing awards are allocated separately. H1 actual earnings/cash are not restated or valued twice.
annual_policy: Hold each v2 pre-SBC operating margin fixed. Replace its embedded SBC percentage with the new future-grant percentage, reducing base margins by1.2 percentage points. No offsetting cut to other costs. Recompute NOPAT and funded reinvestment under the unchanged incremental-return policy.

legacy_recognition_diagnostic.schedule: Straight-line diagnostic only; weighted period is not a contractual amortization schedule. In an illustrative accounting reconciliation, subtract and reverse identical legacy recognition. Both entries cancel; no incremental EV credit, cash payment or separate970.8 claim is added. Full legacy awards receive denominator allocation once.

tax_policy: Scenario normalized cash-tax rates apply to economic operating profit. No separate legacy-vesting tax windfall or deferred-tax asset credit.
